title: Nadia — L'artisane invisible
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive character, high quality render

character.name: Nadia
character.description: Nadia, a 30-year-old North African woman, curly dark hair tied up, flour-dusted apron over a burgundy blouse, warm determined face, expressive hands of a pastry artisan

scenes.vo: Les gâteaux de Nadia partent en une heure. À chaque fois qu'elle poste, tout est vendu.
scenes.image_prompt: Nadia in her small home kitchen proudly finishing magnificent oriental pastries, phone showing sold-out notifications, warm golden kitchen light
scenes.motion_prompt: She dusts sugar over pastries, notifications pop on the phone screen, steam rises softly

scenes.vo: Son rêve : sa pâtisserie. Sa vitrine. Son nom en lettres dorées.
scenes.image_prompt: Nadia pausing at night in front of an empty storefront with a for-rent sign, imagining her name on the facade, reflections in the glass, dreamy warm light
scenes.motion_prompt: She looks up at the empty facade, a subtle glow suggests her imagined golden sign appearing then fading

scenes.vo: Mais entre elle et ce rêve, il y a un mur : pas de local, pas de réseau, personne dans le métier.
scenes.image_prompt: Nadia at her kitchen table late at night with notebooks of plans and numbers, looking overwhelmed, dim lamp, pastry boxes stacked around
scenes.motion_prompt: She rubs her forehead over the notebooks, the lamp flickers, boxes tower around her

scenes.vo: Le pire ? Voir des concurrents moins bons réussir. Parce qu'eux, « ils connaissent du monde ».
scenes.image_prompt: Nadia scrolling her phone seeing a rival bakery's grand opening photos with crowds, her face a mix of hurt and determination, blue phone light
scenes.motion_prompt: She scrolls slowly, jaw tightens, then she puts the phone face down with resolve

scenes.vo: Alors Nadia tente une soirée networking Nour Meet. Des restaurateurs. Des traiteurs. Des gens du métier, enfin.
scenes.image_prompt: Nadia entering a warm restaurant networking evening, welcomed by professionals, she carries a box of her pastries, nervous but hopeful smile
scenes.motion_prompt: She steps in, someone welcomes her warmly, she offers her pastry box, faces light up

scenes.vo: À une table, un traiteur goûte sa corne de gazelle. Il en cherchait une comme ça depuis des mois.
scenes.image_prompt: A distinguished caterer tasting her pastry with closed eyes of delight while Nadia watches anxiously, other guests leaning in, candlelight
scenes.motion_prompt: The caterer tastes, pauses, opens his eyes impressed, Nadia's anxious face breaks into joy

scenes.vo: Six mois plus tard, ses boîtes portent son logo. Et son nom circule dans tous les événements de la ville.
scenes.image_prompt: Elegant catering event with towers of pastry boxes bearing Nadia's golden logo, Nadia in professional attire supervising proudly, glamorous venue
scenes.motion_prompt: Staff carry her branded boxes through the venue, she watches with quiet pride, lights sparkle

scenes.vo: Ton talent mérite d'être connu. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
